generator.notes: Use this JSON as the single source for blog image prompts and output filenames.

styleGuide.description: Prosepal blog images - warm isometric 3D illustrations with emotional depth
styleGuide.aspectRatio: 16:9 (1600x900 preferred for generation); 16:10 fallback. Export/crop 1200x630 for OG where possible.

background.style: Deep dark base with subtle radial glow using category accent color at 15-25% opacity from center; cinematic depth

styleGuide.illustrationStyle: 3D isometric illustration, clean geometric shapes and platforms, soft glows and gradients, no photoreal people or faces
styleGuide.lighting: Soft ambient with category-colored rim lighting and atmospheric bloom; shadows cast on isometric ground plane
styleGuide.mood: Warm, emotionally resonant, modern - isometric precision with human warmth
styleGuide.cameraAngle: Classic isometric 3-point perspective, slightly elevated, objects centered on platform
styleGuide.notes: Do not render words, letters, watermarks, app UI screenshots, logos, or photoreal faces.

sympathy.rimLight: cool blue rim light from upper-left

birthday.rimLight: warm amber rim light from upper-right
